label: In Aquinas' ST I q.3 a.4 first proof, each…, from Aquinas' first proof in ST I q.3 a.4… and 1 more
description: Conditional typed transcription of Aquinas' first q.3 a.4 proof. The causal-exhaustiveness premise and no-essential-self-causation premise remain sourced but philosophically undefended; neither is discharged by this proof, and there is no inference to God or divine simplicity.
